name: upload_begin
description: Reserve a file to upload to the terminal's machine, such as one the user dropped on the terminal, and get a ticket for the rex.data.bytes.v1 data stream that carries its bytes. Once every file of the batch has arrived, the terminal types their paths as if the user had pasted them.

ref.description: The data reference for the file's stream: upload: followed by a new UUID in lower-case canonical form, which the client chooses.

name.description: The file's name. Only its last path component is used, without control characters.

size.description: The file's exact size in bytes.

batch.description: An ID the client chooses for a group of files whose paths are typed together. Left out, the file is uploaded on its own.

index.description: The file's position in its batch, from 0. Paths are typed in this order.

count.description: How many files the batch has. Required with batch.

ticket.description: A single-use ticket to send in the HELLO message that opens the data connection. Only a data connection from the same user can use it.

expires_in_ms.description: How long the ticket stays valid after the server issues it, in milliseconds.

validation_notes: Call it as `com.superlogical.terminal.upload_begin` with `session_id`, `block_id`, and this method's own arguments under `args`.
